title: Perspectives of persons with physical disabilities on obstacles to marriage
core_idea: To investigate, from the perspectives of persons with physical disabilities, the perceived impediments to marriage by administering a 22‑item questionnaire organized into four dimensions (physical disability‑related, psychological, support‑system/social, economic) to 442 participants and analyzing responses using means, standard deviations, and ANOVA to examine associations with demographic and academic variables.
tldr: Survey study of 442 people with physical disabilities using a 22‑item instrument across four obstacle domains to identify and analyze perceived barriers to marriage and their association with participant characteristics (descriptive stats and ANOVA).
